title: Enter image requests get a clearer path
summary:
Enter image requests got a clearer path, Flux stopped quietly changing models on failure, and the sites tidied up their icons.

Image requests from Enter now bypass the per-IP queue, and its nanobanana requests skip the per-IP hourly check. Other image requests have tighter queue and concurrency limits.

When Flux generation fails, the request now returns the original error rather than silently producing an image with a different model.

The main site and Enter received refreshed icons and sharing metadata generated from shared logo files. Enter also gained a web manifest for standalone display.
